signature.name: Apartheid Museum
signature.detail: The essential introduction to South Africa's 20th-century history, with powerful exhibits on segregation and the struggle for freedom. Book tickets online in advance and allow at least two hours; it's a short drive from central Johannesburg.

signature.name: Soweto
signature.detail: The sprawling township is a living monument to South Africa's past and present, best explored with a local guide. Visit on a weekday morning for a calmer experience and to see daily life in action.

signature.name: Mandela House
signature.detail: Nelson Mandela's former home in Soweto offers an intimate look at his early life and the anti-apartheid movement. Combine it with a broader Soweto tour; tickets are available on site.

signature.name: Constitution Hill
signature.detail: A former prison turned constitutional court and museum, telling stories of justice and human rights. Guided tours run regularly; wear comfortable shoes for the uneven grounds.

signature.name: Gold Reef City
signature.detail: A theme park and casino complex built around a historic gold mine, offering rides and underground tours. Check ride schedules in advance and book tickets online to skip queues.

signature.name: Carlton Centre
signature.detail: Once Africa's tallest building, its top-floor observation deck gives sweeping views over the city. Go on a clear day; the viewing area has limited hours, so check before you visit.

signature.name: Ponte City
signature.detail: This iconic cylindrical tower is a symbol of Johannesburg's urban renewal. While not generally open to the public, it's best viewed from nearby neighbourhoods or on a guided city tour.

signature.name: Maboneng Precinct
signature.detail: A revitalised urban hub full of street art, independent shops and cafes, perfect for a stroll. Visit on a weekend when the area is liveliest, and keep an eye on your belongings.

food: Casual meal $8-15; street food and fast food under $8
transport: Ride-hailing apps $5-10 for short trips; minibus taxis very cheap
